hint.en:
Parameter 101: Expert setting

Add the values: 
1 - kWh (total)
2 - W (total)
4 - V (total)
8 - A (total)
256 - W (Channel 1)
512 - W (Channel 2)
2048 - kWh (Channel 1)
4096 - kWh (Channel 2)
65536 - V (Channel 1)
131072 - V (Channel 2)
524288 - A (Channel 1)
1048576 - A (Channel 2)
